approved_claim_dependencies.claim: The v19 Page Load Time diagnostic can expose page-debug timing traces without separate observability setup, helping administrators identify slow page components. Use it for diagnosis and confirm findings with broader telemetry when the issue is intermittent or infrastructure-wide.
